definitions: To understand or comprehend something complex or challenging.
To accept or come to terms with a difficult or unusual idea or situation.
examples: It took me a while to wrap my head around the new software.
She's still trying to wrap her head around the fact that she won the lottery.
I can't wrap my head around why they made that decision.
lemma: to wrap your head around something
synonyms: to come to grips with something
to get your mind around something
source: to wrap your head around something
